validation_ack.reason: Real gap: FY2021 dividend records total Rp900bn = Rp400bn pre-IPO dividend (circular resolution 9 Jun 2021, paid Jun-Jul 2021 to the eight pre-IPO holders, FS2021 Note 23 PDF p. 94; prospectus PDF p. 44 calls it a 2021 interim) + Rp500bn final (AGMS 9 Jun 2022). The company's reported payout ratio 63.27% (AGMS 2022 summary of minutes; AR2022 p. 14) covers only the Rp500bn final, so profit x payout = Rp500bn vs Rp900bn.

research_notes: Identity: PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk ('Cimory'; brands Cimory dairy and Kanzler processed meat), IDR reporter, consolidated FS in Rp juta (stored / 1,000 as IDR billion). Legal name unchanged since the IPO (FS2021-FS2025 and 9M2026 covers). Controlling shareholder Bambang Sutantio 53.56% at 31 Dec 2025 (FS2025 Note 19); General Atlantic bought 5.64% (447,777,778 shares) from existing holders in Jan 2023 (press release 10 Jan 2023, https://www.cimory.com/news-detail.php?news_id=13) - no new shares.

IPO and listing: 1,190,203,000 new shares at Rp3,080 (Rp3,665.8 bn gross, net Rp3,569,667 juta after costs), OJK effective 26 Nov 2021, listed 6 Dec 2021 (prospectus PDF p. 1; FS2025 Note 20). Shares 6,744,480,000 -> 7,934,683,000. The IPO is not a rights issue. FY2019-FY2020 are pre-IPO years: their figures come from the audited FS re-issued for the IPO (Ch. XIX of the final prospectus, auditors' reports 21 Sep 2021); they equal the FY2020 comparatives in FS2021. No year-end price exists for FY2020 (null).

Pre-listing share history, deliberately NOT in corporate_actions (no market, no ex-date, no effect on any stored per-share value): circular shareholder resolution No. 104 of 23 Jun 2021 (MoLHR receipt AHU-AH.01.03-0398353 of 24 Jun 2021) changed the nominal value from Rp100 to Rp10 per share, i.e. a 1:10 split of 674,448,000 into 6,744,480,000 shares (FS2021 Note 21, PDF p. 91; Note 32, PDF p. 104). FY2020 EPS and shares_out are stored on the post-split basis the company prints (same approach as BREN/PGEO).

Corporate actions since listing (6 Dec 2021 - 4 Nov 2026): none. Issued capital is 7,934,683,000 shares of Rp10 in every FS from FY2021 to 30 Sep 2026 and there are no treasury shares. AR2022 p. 14, AR2023 p. 16, AR2024 p. 18 and AR2025 p. 16 each state that the company did no stock split, reverse split, bonus issue or change of nominal value in the year; the 2022-2026 AGMS agendas (summaries of minutes on cimory.com/general-meeting.php) contain no share-capital item; the Apr-2023 EGMS amended articles 3 and 20 only and the Jun-2024 EGMS was about adding business lines (KBLI). The MESOP approved on 18 Aug 2021 (up to 10% of capital, prospectus PDF p. 16) has not produced any new shares. corporate_actions is therefore an empty list and fy.2019.year_end_price is not needed.

Debt: CMRY is essentially debt-free. total_debt sums short- and long-term bank loans plus 'utang pembiayaan konsumen jangka panjang' (interest-bearing machinery/vehicle financing, mostly from AB Svensk Exportkredit in USD; secured on the machines), current + non-current: Rp71.8 bn (2019), 49.7 bn (2020), 41.6 bn (2021), 34.6 bn (2022); the SEK financing was repaid on 5 Jun 2023 and borrowings are nil from FY2023 to 9M2026 (BCA overdraft facilities unused). Lease liabilities (PSAK 73) are tiny and excluded. Bank-only borrowings would be 15.4 bn (2019), 0.16 bn (2020), 0 (2021), 0.01 bn (2022).

Cash vs securities: from FY2022 the company holds large 'Investasi pada surat berharga' (government bonds in IDR and USD, mutual funds; Rp2.83 tn at end-2025, Rp2.66 tn at 30 Sep 2026) outside 'kas dan setara kas'. cash therefore understates liquidity; the company's own 'net cash' in its decks includes these bonds.

Dividends: (a) pre-IPO Rp400bn (Rp593.08 per Rp100 share = Rp59.3 per post-split share) approved by circular resolution 9 Jun 2021 and paid Jun-Jul 2021 to the eight pre-IPO holders; the prospectus calls it a 2021 interim dividend, so it is recorded as fy 2021 interim with dps null (not paid on the listed share base). (b) Post-IPO: FY2021 final Rp63.01, FY2022 Rp70, FY2023 Rp90, FY2024 Rp150, FY2025 interim Rp100 + final Rp100, FY2026 interim Rp100 (paid 18 Sep 2026). Dates and DPS from the AGMS summaries of minutes on cimory.com (schedule tables) and KSEI notices (web.ksei.co.id, relaying the issuer's notification); the two interims (Oct 2025, Sep 2026) are sourced from KSEI because the company's interim announcement letters are not on its website. All KSEI notices agree with the AGMS schedules. The company's payout ratios use consolidated profit for the year INCLUDING NCI (e.g. FY2021 Rp790,229 juta); NCI is under 0.01% so this does not matter. FY2020 payout: null (no dividend declared out of FY2020 profit; prospectus p. 70: no dividend distributed in 2020).

EBITDA: reported only in the annual-report highlights (no definition there); the IPO prospectus (PDF p. 47/49) defines it as operating profit before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation. FY2021 is stored as first reported in AR2021 (1,077,350 Rp juta); AR2022-AR2024 print 1,073,904 for 2021 without explanation. The quarterly results decks and interim FS do not report EBITDA, so interim ebitda_ytd/_prior are null.

Capex = 'Perolehan aset tetap' + 'Pembayaran uang muka perolehan aset tetap' (advances paid for fixed assets, later reclassified to fixed assets as a non-cash item, e.g. FS2025 Note 36) from the investing section of each FS; additions to right-of-use and intangible assets are excluded. Without the advances line capex would be 101.3 / 244.9 / 667.0 / 455.4 / 337.2 / 518.2 bn for 2020-2025.
ROE/ROA are stored as printed in each AR's ratio table (profit for the year incl. NCI over year-end total equity / total assets); AR2025's 2025 ROE 29.8% does not reproduce from the FS (30.0%).

Restatements: none found. Every FY2020-FY2024 comparative column in the next year's FS equals the originally reported figure for revenue, gross profit, operating profit, profit attributable, EPS, total assets, liabilities, equity, cash, CFO and capex lines. FS2025 relabels 'Penjualan neto' as 'Pendapatan dari kontrak dengan pelanggan' (same amount for 2024).

9M2026: revenue +26.1% YoY, profit attributable +7.3%; operating profit hit by a Rp95.2 bn loss from two warehouse fires in June 2026 (interim FS Note 7, PDF p. 43; insurance claim pending, not recognised) and higher input costs (9M2026 deck p. 6-7, p. 18).

Self-check (build script): every stored printed value (192 strings) was found on its cited PDF page; EPS x shares vs profit attributable within 0.02% for FY2020-FY2025; profit attributable x payout vs approved dividend totals within 0.01% for FY2022-FY2025 (FY2021 see validation_ack); balance sheets tie (assets = liabilities + total equity) for 2019-2025 and 30 Sep 2026.
